mechanic: multi-lane serve-and-dispatch time-manager — work a counter of parallel lanes, sliding filled orders down a lane to slake advancing patrons who push back toward you, then catching the empties they return before they smash on the floor; patrons queue faster and walk quicker as the shift ramps; serve out a whole rush to clear the round and grab a tip-token for a brief slow-motion burst — but let a patron reach your end, or miss a returning empty, and you burn one of three lives
theme: synthwave neon bar — a glowing barkeep skates a chrome counter of magenta lanes, sliding luminous tumblers at cyan patron-silhouettes under VHS bloom and a pulsing marquee
seo_target: lane serving time management game unblocked
